reviews.title: Over 40 years of building systems, the BEST and EASIEST cooler I have ever used.
reviews.comment: Firstly, I am not paid to review nor received any discount on my purchase. I have been building systems since DOS plus and Windows 1 was new. (yeah, I AM old) I have built over a thousand systems, installed and administered networks from 4 users to 110 users. Matching the proper cooling solution to the CPU used to come all together in the same box. With the speed, multiple cores and billions of transistors in modern high performance CPU's, cooling has massively evolved. This heat sink / fan system is an absolute renaissance in design. Super clear instructions, the easiest installation of a dual fan cooler coupled with everything needed to install (yes, very long skinny Phillips screwdriver too) made this a joy instead of the usual fight this, cuss that, find a dual to single adapter for the fan connectors.. This cooler was made to both almost install itself and cool a 3.4 GHz processor OC'd to 5.1 and keep things working. I have tried many, MANY coolers and unless I have a client that needs a Threadripper, I will only buy and use these in the future. I would give it 11 stars if I were able to do so. Five stars seems an insult.  It IS that easy and capable. Did I forget to mention extremely budget oriented to boot????
reviews.author: JB

reviews.title: Cooled to 35C, quiet fans, very good result
reviews.comment:
Very pleased with result. Brought Temp down to 35C under heavy cpu load. Before installing this cooler my pc used to run at 90C for a while due to faulty cooler. Replacing it with this item fixed it.
Easy installation for someone who is used to assemble computers. The very long screwdriver that is included is essential for installation.
Easily fit into my Corsair ATX case and onto Asrock X99 extreme4 motherboard with intel LGA2011 socket.
Thermal paste is included, easy to apply.
Takes up a lot of space, this thing is big and still managed to fit with some clearance between the ram and the cooler. The fans run quietly.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Keeps a Ryzen 9 5900x cool enough under high CPU loads
reviews.comment: We all know the struggle of cooling a Ryzen 9 5900x in an ATX mid case. This cooler, along with some good thermal paste and good air flow planning will keep your CPU in the 50C-60C range. It installs easily with several mounting options and they even provide a long, skinny screwdriver to install it.  It's pretty quiet, even on high speed performance. It's  also designed to stay out of the way of your RAM, via It's off center design. It is a BIG cooler. Don't expect to use it in a micro ATX case and don't expect tp use side foor fans, unless your case is very wide. Great performance so far and a good value for the money. I'm not a big ARBG guy, but it's very bright.
